verdict.rationale: Evidence shows sign-in via ChatGPT Plus/Pro/Business/Edu/Enterprise plans and API-key auth (codex-gh-3, codex-gh-4), which hints at enterprise account tiers but provides no detail on SSO/SAML, cloud IAM integration, or compliance-grade identity federation expected by engineering leads.
